title: 跨期补充：Ncell拓展旅游渠道合作
titleEn: Prior-period context: Ncell expands tourism-channel cooperation
text: Ncell官网确认与尼泊尔旅游运营商协会（NATO，非北约）签署合作备忘录，通过旅游业渠道推广游客通信服务。Taksar已于9月18日报道；NepaliTelecom的9月21日更新时间不代表合作在本期首次发生。此项补充保留供持续跟踪，不纳入本期新增新闻或商机数量。
textEn: Ncell's official release confirms an MoU with the Nepal Association of Travel Operators (NATO, not the military alliance) to promote tourist connectivity through travel-industry channels. Taksar reported it on 18 September; NepaliTelecom's 21 September update is not evidence of a new current-period event. This catch-up is retained for follow-up and excluded from current news and opportunity counts.
analysis: 跟进方向：向Ncell确认实际参与旅行社、游客SIM/eSIM激活流程、重点旅游线路覆盖及渠道转化数据。合作意向不等于渠道已全面上线，更不能据此推断设备采购或厂家中标。
analysisEn: Follow-up: ask Ncell which travel agencies are participating, how tourist SIM/eSIM activation works, which tourism routes require coverage, and what conversion data are available. An MoU does not establish full channel rollout, equipment procurement or a vendor award.
